name: Deep Link and Protocol Handler Lifecycle
description: Handle tribunus:// protocol links: open workspace, join session, approve action, view artifact. Security review per handler.
purpose: Deep links are powerful and safe.
acceptanceCriteria: Each deep link action is a registered handler with explicit parameter schema and capability requirements
Handlers validate all parameters before acting; malformed links are rejected with user-visible error
Handlers that mutate state require user confirmation before execution
Every handler invocation is logged with source, parameters, and outcome
Deep link registration on OS is verified at startup
Handlers are scoped — a workspace handler cannot invoke session-administrative actions
required_evidence: Handler registration with parameter schema and capability requirements test
Parameter validation and rejection of malformed links test
User confirmation gate for state-mutating handlers test
Handler scope enforcement test (workspace handler cannot call session-administrative action)
acceptance_gates: Each handler has explicit parameter schema and capability requirements
Malformed links rejected with user-visible error
Every invocation logged with source, parameters, outcome
rollback_strategy: Deep link handlers validate before acting — no rollback needed for rejected links. Mutating handlers are wrapped in an action that can be cancelled
recovery_strategy: If a deep link handler crashes mid-execution, the action is recorded as failed and the user can retry
escalation_policy: Deep link handler failure escalates to user with the original link and error details
